neighbours.label: the point in a help or service instruction where someone else is about to act for the reader (', and one of our staff will', 'have someone else', 'be sure your doctor'); its output promotes 'someone'
fire: If you would like a quote, complete the short form and a member of our team will reply within a day.
Questions about your order? Send us a message, and one of our advisors will get back to you.
After the surgery, have a friend or relative drive you home.
If you feel faint, ask someone nearby to call an ambulance.
Leave your number at the front desk and a nurse will call you back.
Not sure which size to buy? Contact us and an expert will help you choose.
Before starting the new diet, make sure your doctor knows about any allergies.
If the alarm goes off, wait by the door and a technician will come to reset it.
quiet: If you would like a quote, the prices are listed on our website.
Questions about your order are usually answered in our FAQ section.
After the surgery, she drove home and slept for the rest of the day.
When he felt faint, he sat on the bench and drank some water.
The front desk is open from eight in the morning until six.
Our shirts come in small, medium and large sizes.
The new diet includes fruit, vegetables and whole grains.
The alarm went off twice last night because of the wind.

notes: Card: ' and' before 'one of our staff', ' have' someone else, ' sure' your doctor; output promotes someone/somebody/anyone (the - pole fires on 'Anyone'/'someone'). Probe: form-and-agent request fired at 1.05, 'apples and oranges' silent.
